fix.cause: The write gate admitted a telemetry transaction after 16 rapid priority skips while a critical command remained registered. The telemetry thread could repeatedly reacquire the SQLite write lock before the critical worker woke. Priority deferrals already requeue without consuming telemetry row retry budget, so the bypass was obsolete and unsafe.
fix.implementation: A registered critical command now exclusively owns the next write-transaction admission until it acquires and releases the gate; telemetry priority deferrals remain non-consuming and lossless.
fix.red: test_continuous_queued_critical_work_never_yields_lock_to_telemetry failed because the 17th telemetry attempt was admitted
